verdicts.reason: Both candidates move the building photo in from the left edge and leave roughly 170px of empty white strip beside it. Each also leaves a large dead zone to the right of the right-aligned headline, so the composition looks like a shrunk copy floating in the canvas rather than a re-laid banner. A's headline is noticeably smaller and weaker at this slim height, while B's headline is larger and keeps the original's dominance and scale relative to the photo, which makes B the less bad of the two.
